body_markdown:
Palladyne AI (PDYN) announced a strategic collaboration with FANUC America, bringing together FANUC's industrial robots with Palladyne IQ, PDYN's physical-AI software platform.


The companies plan to work on:


-


AI-driven motion planning and adaptive robot behavior


-


Teleoperation and human-assisted learning


-


Simulation and AI model training


-


Joint validation of real-world customer applications


-


Standardized deployment workflows


Palladyne's pitch is essentially to add an intelligence layer that helps robots adapt to changing environments and perform a wider variety of tasks.


That makes FANUC an interesting partner: FANUC brings the robotics hardware and industrial footprint; Palladyne brings the AI software.


There is an important caveat. No financial terms, customer deployments or expected revenue were announced. This is a development and validation collaboration, not yet a major commercial contract.
